selection: OUT-OF-FOLD (stored 9-fold LODO scores, ARTIFACTS/exp012/oof_scores.json); enter iff score >= frozen threshold; same entered set for every variant

skipped.reason: identical exit to the reference tpsl_tp50_sl30

winners_curse: 17 exit variants were tried on the same 9 days the model was frozen on. Picking the best of them is a selection: its mean is biased upward and the rank below is not evidence. Compare variants on day stability and CI width, not on the top row.
caveats: only the exit rule changes; entry is the frozen k=1 'start'
exploration pool, same 9 days the model was frozen on; OOF removes the model's own-day fit, not the winner's curse of the variant choice
per-day means are small-n cells (about 100 entered trades per day on average); a positive-day count is a coarse stability read

tries.also_run: nested-LODO selection over the same variants (one selection procedure, not a variant)

nested_lodo.selection_rule: per held-out day: variant with the best pooled pressure paired mean on the other days (reference = 0 is a candidate); scored on the held-out day
nested_lodo.fast_only_label: all-days selection rule, scored on fast days (about 3-4 days, coarse)

exit_side_latency: not implemented: tools/exploration_exits.py fixes the exit's landing delay to its entry constants (_delayed(..., ENTRY_LAND_K, ENTRY_BOUND, ENTRY_BOUND)) and a time-cap exit has no delay at all; there is no parameter for a delayed exit fill, and this PR does not add exit logic. The k in {1, 4, 8} exit-side check for the reference and the top-3 variants is not run.
